NLR provided TA to Moore Street Seniors, Inc, from Nov. 2024 to Jan. 2025. 1.1 Moore Street Seniors, Inc. Moore Street Seniors, Inc. is a nonprofit organization that supports seniors living in Interior Alaska by providing safe and affordable housing through the operation of a residential multifamily building1. The 20-unit Moore Street Senior Apartments building is located directly across from the Senior Center in Fairbanks, Alaska, and provides residents with a place to live and opportunities for social activities, access to the Senior Center for meals and services, and programming such as gardening and exercise classes. The Moore Street Senior Apartment building is approximately 30 years old (see Figures 1 and 2). The goal of Moore Street Seniors, Inc. is to renovate the building so that it is efficient, safe, and healthy for the next several decades to enable the continuation of their mission to serve seniors in Fairbanks. The Expert Match technical assistance timeframe is 40–60 hours over 3–4 months. Moore Street Seniors, Inc. was selected as a participant in the E2C Expert Match program because of their need for technical input and best practices for making critical building, mechanical, and envelope improvements to benefit their residents and save energy to reduce annual costs. 2 Objective The objective of this Expert Match project is to provide technical input based on past energy bills, conversations with Moore Street Seniors, Inc. staff, and findings from a limited-scope on- site building survey, on the following: • A list of considerations for window replacements, because Moore Street Seniors, Inc., has obtained funding to replace all windows in the building. • The feasibility of installing a new ventilation system, as the building currently relies on exhaust-only ventilation. Considerations should include details on a potential system or different options if they exist, and the advantages and disadvantages of the options. • A list of other potentially cost-effective retrofit options identified during the building survey. This technical input is intended to assist Moore Street Seniors, Inc., to reduce energy costs and improve occupant comfort and indoor air quality. 3 Moore Street Senior Apartments The Moore Street Senior Apartments is a 20-unit apartment complex with two common rooms and an office.
